Work is currently ongoing to improve and enhance the overall framework.

history.sg_progress: The comprehensive policy simplification process will continue as one of the core functions of the Office of Human Resources, with a focus on prioritizing strategic and transformational policy development and revision. The Umoja solution supports the implementation of policies and customization of standard SAP functionalities is undertaken as required. Any customization reflects the principle mandated by the General Assembly, summarized in the report of the Secretary- General on enterprise systems for the United Nations Secretariat worldwide (A/62/510/Rev.1, para. 22 (c)): “Customization of the enterprise resource planning software should be kept to a minimum, to avoid unnecessary costs”. Considering the broad and ongoing nature of this recommendation, the Administration requests its closure by the Board.
